records.name: Saibabeam
records.effect: Green energy wave fired from the Saibaman head gland.

notes: This batch intentionally avoids treating the cast-exclusive list as proof of Ki Blast taxonomy. Life Absorption and Smile Charge have dedicated Xenoverse 2 documentation explicitly classifying them as Strike Supers. Saibabeam is established as a Super Skill used by Saibamen variants; exact Ki cost is left null. Acid is recorded as a cast-only Saibaman skill based on the cross-check source, with exact cost left null. Rocket Punch is a cast-only Android 16 Super Skill; its exact Xenoverse 2 attack-type metadata was not sufficiently established by the sources found, so it is conservatively classified Strike based on its physical rocket-fist implementation; this should remain an audit candidate if a stronger dedicated source is found.
